prompt: Write code (BASIC or 6510 assembly) to play roughly a one-second note on voice 1 of the SID using a sawtooth waveform, with a simple envelope.
assertions: Sets master volume in $D418 / 54296 (low nibble, e.g. 15)
Sets the voice 1 control register $D404 to a sawtooth+gate value (sawtooth bit 32 + gate 1 = 33)
Clears the gate bit afterwards to release the note
